hero.title: Engineering and software for connected products.
hero.lead: Linqore designs, builds and supports connected products end to end: embedded firmware, IoT connectivity, web platforms and mobile apps, engineered together so your devices, data and people work as one system.

quote.text: Clear scope, careful engineering and honest communication, from the first conversation to long after launch.

pipeline.d: Model the system and test the control logic on a computer before any hardware is bought.
Build and program the device: sensors, control logic, alerts and low power use on the board.
Connect devices securely to the cloud, sending data up and commands and updates back down.
Device data is stored in a cloud database and shown on live dashboards with history, reports and alerts for your team.

services.title: What we build
services.sub: Hardware and software engineering under one roof, delivered against a single written scope.

items.d: Company websites, customer portals and admin systems that are fast, secure and easy for your team to manage.
The code that runs on the device: reading sensors, controlling motors and relays, saving power and handling faults.
Secure connection between the device and a server, data storage, remote commands and over-the-air updates.
Screens that show what your system is doing, send commands and raise alerts, built for the people who use the system every day.
Model the machine, tank, motor or building and run the firmware against it, so mistakes show up before real hardware is involved.
Connect devices to the systems you already use, help with installation and keep the software working after delivery.

about.title: About us
about.intro: Linqore is an engineering and software company based in Islamabad. We take ownership of the complete connected system, from the firmware on the device to the platform and apps your team relies on every day.
about.story:
Most organisations do not need another isolated tool. They need devices, connectivity, platforms and applications that work together reliably as one system.
That is the responsibility we take on. We define the requirement, model the system where hardware is involved, build and test the software, and hand over a platform your team can operate with confidence.
Every engagement begins with a written scope and quotation, and ends with a documented, working system and an agreed support arrangement.

values.d: We simulate hardware and control logic first, so design mistakes are caught while they are still cheap to fix.
Firmware, connectivity and applications are designed together by one team, so every part fits and nothing falls between suppliers.
You know exactly what will be delivered, when, and at what cost before any work begins.

projects.title: Projects
projects.sub: A selection of systems we have designed and delivered, from firmware on the device to the application that controls it.

items.d: Fingerprint attendance on ESP32. Admins enrol and remove people from a mobile app, each scan is time-stamped and sent to the server over HTTP, and removing a company revokes access for all of its users.
Reads and writes NFC card data from a mobile app in text and hex form, and copies the contents of one card onto another.
Switches a relay on a schedule taken from an RTC or from the network, with timer mode in minutes and direct control from a mobile app.
Measures voltage and current with sensors on an ESP32 and publishes the readings over MQTT, so power use can be monitored remotely on a mobile screen.
Measures irradiance, temperature and operating voltage and current, plots the I-V curve and operating point in Python, locates a fault on screen and disconnects the faulty panel through a relay.
A YOLOv5 model trained on a labelled human dataset in PyTorch, with tuned hyperparameters and epochs, for real-time person detection.
Reads heart rate, blood oxygen, body temperature and GPS location with an ESP32 and sends them over GSM to the Blynk IoT app for remote viewing.

items.q: How do I get a quotation?
items.a: Send the request form on this page or message us on WhatsApp. We review your requirements and reply with a written scope, timeline and itemised price.

items.q: Which technologies do you work with?
items.a: For devices: ESP32, STM32 (ARM Cortex-M), Arduino and Raspberry Pi. For software: web platforms, Android and iOS apps, cloud APIs and MQTT. If you already have systems in place, we build on them.

items.q: Do I need hardware before we start?
items.a: No. Many projects are software only. When a device is needed, we simulate it first and recommend suitable boards and sensors before anything is purchased.
Yes. Our office is in Islamabad. Please call or message us first so we can arrange a time.
You receive the working system, documentation and a short user guide. Ongoing maintenance and support can be agreed as part of your quotation.

comms.title: Communication links and protocols
comms.sub: We connect devices over the link that suits the site, and use the protocol your systems already speak.

links.d: Local networks and direct cloud access for indoor and campus systems.
Remote sites with no Wi-Fi, using mobile data or SMS alerts.
Short-range pairing and setup from a phone app.
Boards, sensors and industrial equipment on a wire.

protocols.d: Lightweight publish and subscribe for sensors and commands.
REST APIs and web services between devices and servers.
Reliable data streams, for example device to PC or server.
Fast, low-latency telemetry where an occasional loss is acceptable.
